```{ojs}
aboutText = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "AboutText"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()).sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 999) - (b.order ?? 999)));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
overviewParagraphs = aboutText.filter(t => t.section === "overview")
```

```{ojs}
disclaimerParagraphs = aboutText.filter(t => t.section === "disclaimer")
```

## App Overview

```{ojs}
overviewParagraphs.length === 0
  ? html`<p>The EVD Toolkit is an educational platform designed to support understanding of external ventricular drain (EVD) management, troubleshooting, transport safety, ICP monitoring principles, and neurocritical care education.</p>`
  : html`<div>${overviewParagraphs.map(p => `<p>${p.text}</p>`).join("")}</div>`
```

## Global Collaborators

```{ojs}
collaborators = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  // Live listener — updates automatically whenever Collaborators
  // changes in Firestore, no page reload needed.
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "Collaborators"), snapshot => {
      notify(
        snapshot.docs
          .map(d => d.data())
          .sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 999) - (b.order ?? 999))
      );
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Port of AboutView.swift's people-sorting rule: ordered items first
// (by order), then unordered items alphabetically by name.
sortPeople = function(people) {
  const ordered = people.filter(p => p.order != null).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  const unordered = people.filter(p => p.order == null).sort((a, b) => (a.name ?? "").localeCompare(b.name ?? ""));
  return [...ordered, ...unordered];
}
```

```{ojs}
isDeveloper = c => (c.Role ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("design")
```

```{ojs}
developers = sortPeople(collaborators.filter(isDeveloper))
```

```{ojs}
collaboratorsList = sortPeople(collaborators.filter(c => !isDeveloper(c)))
```

```{ojs}
function peopleList(people) {
  return people.length === 0
    ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
    : html`<div>${people.map(p => `
        <div class="fs-ref-entry">
          <p class="fs-ref-title">${p.name ?? ""}</p>
          <p class="fs-ref-authors">${p.Role ?? ""}</p>
          <p class="fs-ref-journal">${p.Affiliation ?? ""}${[p.City, p.Country].filter(Boolean).length ? ` — ${[p.City, p.Country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}` : ""}</p>
        </div>
      `).join("")}</div>`
}
```

## Developers

```{ojs}
peopleList(developers)
```

## Collaborators

```{ojs}
peopleList(collaboratorsList)
```
